meta.title: Add several products and delete a row before submitting the purchase intake

args.goal: On the current purchase intake Product Details section, fill a first product row with Product Name, Quantity, Unit of Measure, and Delivery Location; fill a second product in the next row; verify that a new blank row is added after each product entry; click the red bin icon for one product row; stop on the table showing only the remaining kept product row(s) and the newly available blank row.

steps.note: Performs the product-row additions and deletion while verifying the resulting table state on screen.
Confirms the resulting purchase-intake screen has no crash, server error, raw identifiers, or invalid rendering after the row deletion.
